fit_reason: Whole pickup truck offered by a private seller with clear exterior photos.
findings: Hazy, yellowed lens on the front headlights, most visible on the driver side
Rear bumper looks dull and faded, especially across the top step area
Black fender flares and running boards look slightly grayed rather than deep black
Paint on the tailgate and hood looks a bit flat compared to the doors
Rust staining on the exhaust tip and hitch area at the rear
message: Hi, we saw your Tacoma listing and it looks like a solid truck. The headlight lenses are starting to haze and the black flares and rear bumper look a little faded in the photos. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight and trim restoration and a paint polish. Would you like a quote?
